name: Motive
overview: Scripture reveals that motive is central to human actions and divine evaluation, as seen in Cain's struggle with sin where right motive leads to acceptance but wrong motive invites sin's dominion (Genesis 4:7). The motives of the tribes of Reuben and Gad in seeking their inheritance east of the Jordan were misunderstood, illustrating how intentions can be misjudged (Numbers 32:1; Joshua 22:9). Job's story further exposes the complexity of motive, with Satan challenging Job's righteousness as being self-interested rather than genuine fear of God (Job 1:9; 2:4-5), highlighting that true motive must be pure and God-centered.
